subject: Qualification follow-up: procurement readiness & billing start for Nova Networks trial
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@novanetworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 15:00:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & trial conversion checkpoints

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have clear handoffs to procurement and success: 

Summary:
- Pilot: 30-day trial starting when you confirm data ingest and tooling access.
- Success criteria (for trial-to-paid): average >= 10k tokens/day OR 1M total tokens over 30 days; 3 documented successful flows in production-like traffic; acceptable latency under 350ms p50 for your top 3 endpoints.

Action items for Nova:
1) Confirm procurement path: PO (preferred by your finance?) vs company card vs marketplace purchase.
2) Share PO contact and expected timeline (we can accept signed PO + Master SLA).
3) Confirm go-live date for trial (we can start onboarding once access is scheduled).

What Redwood will provide:
- Redacted SOW template and onboarding playbook (attached).
- SOC2 exec summary and W-9 for vendor onboarding (I’ll attach these to the thread).
- A short metrics file that maps our telemetry to your success criteria (attached: trial-success-metrics.csv).

If procurement needs a dedicated checklist, ask Raj (procurement lead) to share the vendor onboarding requirements and I’ll have Laura coordinate legal/finance on our side. Our preference is to begin billing on the first invoice cycle after PO acceptance, but we can be flexible if you need billing to start only after success gates are met — happy to align.

Proposed dates:
- Onboarding kickoff: Mon, 26 Apr 2027
- Trial start window: 27–29 Apr 2027
- Billing start: First billing cycle after PO is issued (or 30 days after trial start if PO is delayed) — we can lock this in once procurement confirms preference.

Next step: can you confirm preferred procurement route and share the PO contact? I’ll loop Laura to get SOC2/W9 over.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-commercial-playbook.pdf, trial-success-metrics.csv
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@novanetworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novanetworks.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novanetworks.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & trial conversion checkpoints

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from procurement's side: 

- Nova procurement typically issues a PO for platform contracts. We prefer a PO attached to an MSA rather than credit card for anything over $20k.
- Our PO lead is Raj Patel (cc’d). Raj — can you confirm our internal timeline? We generally need net-30 from PO receipt but can expedite for pilots if finance signs off.

On success criteria: the thresholds look fine. One ask — can Redwood provide a short doc that maps the "3 documented successful flows" into the format our Product team needs for sign-off? A checklist or 1-page table would be ideal.

We’ll review the SOW/playbook and confirm a tentative trial start date next week.

Best,
Emma
VP Product | Nova Networks

Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 17:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & trial conversion checkpoints

Folks —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement prefers PO for this engagement. Two items from our side: 
1) Please provide Redwood's W-9 and SOC2 summary to speed the vendor setup.
2) I’m attaching our vendor onboarding checklist; finance will need the PO to reference an SOW or MSA and the total expected monthly/annual spend. Can you provide an estimated first-month invoice amount for the pilot? Even a range helps.

We can usually turn a PO in ~7–10 business days once vendor documents are in our system; if Redwood can accept a signed PO that references Master SLA, we can get internal approvals faster.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Vendor Operations Manager | Nova Networks
Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@novanetworks.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@novanetworks.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & trial conversion checkpoints — billing and onboarding mechanics

Hi Emma / Raj —

Thanks for the quick responses. I’m Laura on the onboarding and finance side. A few clarifications from Redwood to make procurement easier: 

- I’ve attached our W-9 and a short SOC2 executive summary (W9_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_exec_summary.pdf).
- Estimated first-month pilot invoice: $4,500–$7,000 (range depends on tokens used during onboarding). We can issue a pro-forma invoice that references the expected pilot cap to attach to the PO.
- Billing start: our standard is to start billing on the first invoice cycle after PO acceptance. If Nova requires billing to wait until the success criteria are met, we can either: (a) hold billing until post-trial sign-off, or (b) start billing but issue credit for the pilot period if success gates are not met. Option (a) requires procurement confirmation that the PO will cover the pilot period post-signature.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I’ll upload the W-9 and SOC2 summary to your vendor portal today.
2) Rishi will send the 1-page success-checklist formatted for your Product team (per Emma).
3) If Raj can confirm target PO submission date, we’ll draft the pro-forma invoice and SOW reference for your PO.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
Attachments: W9_Redwood.pdf, SOC2_exec_summary.pdf
